title.en: An Act Converting the Pampanga Trade School in the Municipality of Bacolor, Province of Pampanga, into a Regional School of Arts and Trades to be Known as the Pampanga School of Arts and Trades, and to Authorize the Appropriation of Funds for the Purpose

text.en: The Pampanga Trade School in the Municipality of Bacolor, Province of Pampanga, is hereby converted into a regional school of arts and trades, of the Philippine School of Arts and Trades type, to be known as the Pampanga School of Arts and Trades. The said school shall be under the supervision of the Bureau of Public Schools and subject to the provisions of the School Law. Courses of collegiate and secondary levels shall be offered in the said school.

The sum of two hundred thousand pesos is hereby authorized to be appropriated, out of any funds in the National Treasury not otherwise appropriated, for the expenses of the said school during the fiscal year nineteen hundred fifty-six. Thereafter, the necessary funds for its operation and maintenance shall be included in the annual General Appropriation Acts.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 18, 1955.
